sources.title: ArduPlane TKOFF_TIMEOUT metadata
sources.context_summary_zh: 参数元数据给出自动起飞、4m/s 阈值、超时、abort/disarm 和 0 禁用语义。

unresolved_references: 唯一规范来源是冻结参数元数据，权威等级低。
标准 MAVLink 没有精确 automatic-takeoff start 时间。

trigger.text: 启用 TKOFF_TIMEOUT 的自动起飞开始。

preconditions.text: 从内部 automatic-takeoff start 起，地速在整个窗口内从未达到 4m/s。

obligations.text: 超时后中止 takeoff 并 disarm。

prohibitions.text: 若在窗口内达到至少 4m/s，则不能仅由该 timeout 分支判为违规。

scope_end.text: 达到 4m/s、takeoff abort/disarm、离开 takeoff 或 run 结束

unresolved: 唯一规范来源是冻结参数元数据，权威等级低。
标准 MAVLink 没有精确 automatic-takeoff start 时间。

time_contracts.conversion: MITL interval unit is seconds; runtime seconds use identity conversion.
time_contracts.measurement_uncertainty: No numeric tolerance has a normative source. If transport, scheduling, or sampling uncertainty can change a boundary verdict, the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE.
time_contracts.freshness: Start/end observations must be fresh in the same clock domain; host arrival time is not silently substituted.

mitl.symbolic: G((automatic_takeoff_start & timeout_enabled) -> (G_[0,T_takeoff] speed_below_4mps -> F_[T_takeoff,infty) (takeoff_aborted & F disarmed)))

concrete_instances.notes: 运行时参数值落在官方定义的禁用域；保留数值与来源，但不构造零/负区间公式，当前 profile 没有激活该时间义务。

subformula_evidence.subformula: G((automatic_takeoff_start & timeout_enabled) -> (G_[0,T_takeoff] speed_below_4mps -> F_[T_takeoff,infty) (takeoff_aborted & F disarmed)))

atomic_propositions.name: automatic_takeoff_start
atomic_propositions.controlled_natural_language: 自动起飞计时起点发生。
atomic_propositions.truth_condition: 当前 takeoff attempt 的内部 start epoch 从 unset 变为有效。
atomic_propositions.validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
atomic_propositions.freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
atomic_propositions.scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Per-attempt autopilot monotonic-boot start epoch used by TKOFF_TIMEOUT.
source_bindings.evidence: Plane.h:439-452 defines takeoff_state and its timers. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduPlane/Plane.h#L447

source_bindings.semantic_identity: AUTO takeoff start after launch acceleration/delay/speed/attitude checks trigger.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 124-134 accept the launch and initialize start, level-off, and throttle-max timers. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduPlane/takeoff.cpp#L130

source_bindings.semantic_identity: TAKEOFF-mode start after position/home setup, throttle unsuppressed, and sufficient groundspeed.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 128-136 initialize the takeoff attempt timers and course. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduPlane/mode_takeoff.cpp#L132

mavlink_observations.derivation: Can confirm coarse TAKEOFF/AUTO mode, without the start epoch. HEARTBEAT has no embedded timestamp.

atomic_propositions.controlled_natural_language: 运行时 TKOFF_TIMEOUT 大于零。
atomic_propositions.validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
atomic_propositions.freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Runtime automatic-takeoff timeout in seconds; zero disables.
source_bindings.evidence: AP_GROUPINFO binds TKOFF_TIMEOUT; field type is at Parameters.h:522. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduPlane/Parameters.cpp#L1120

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Direct runtime enable predicate combined with a valid start epoch.
source_bindings.evidence: The function enters timeout logic only when start_time_ms is nonzero and TKOFF_TIMEOUT is positive. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduPlane/takeoff.cpp#L393

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Seconds-to-milliseconds conversion for the runtime timeout.
source_bindings.evidence: The strict greater-than elapsed-time comparison performs the conversion inline. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduPlane/takeoff.cpp#L401

mavlink_observations.derivation: PARAM_VALUE.param_id selects TKOFF_TIMEOUT; truth is param_value > 0; PARAM_VALUE has no timestamp

atomic_propositions.name: speed_below_4mps
atomic_propositions.truth_condition: AP::gps ground speed < 4.0 m/s 且 GPS speed 有效/新鲜。
atomic_propositions.validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
atomic_propositions.freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
atomic_propositions.scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Backend-populated primary GPS ground speed in metres per second.
source_bindings.evidence: GPS_State is filled by the selected backend; inline accessor is at AP_GPS.h:369-373. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_GPS/AP_GPS.h#L197

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Reads the primary GPS ground-speed sample used by the timeout check.
source_bindings.evidence: Lines 394-396 bind the GPS value, literal 4 m/s threshold, and comparison. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduPlane/takeoff.cpp#L394

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Clears the timeout epoch at 4 m/s or above; the else path is the source identity for below 4 m/s.
source_bindings.evidence: Threshold is const float 4 at line 395; lines 396-399 clear the timer on reaching it. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduPlane/takeoff.cpp#L396

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Candidate freshness carrier for the primary GPS instance, separate from ground_speed.
source_bindings.evidence: AP_GPS.h:446-452 exposes last processed GPS-message time; check_takeoff_timeout does not read it. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_GPS/AP_GPS.h#L448

mavlink_observations.derivation: Ground speed in cm/s; predicate is vel < 400 with valid fresh fix. time_usec may be UNIX epoch or system boot per XML.
mavlink_observations.time_field: time_usec (ambiguous UNIX epoch or system boot; GPS fix time)
